svg.aria-label: Gate-level quantum circuit for patch-pair comparison, with an explanation of every gate: amplitude embedding, RX RY RZ rotations carrying re-uploaded pixel data, a CNOT entangling ring, offset encoding, and the swap test of Hadamard, six controlled swaps, two controlled rotations, Hadamard and Pauli-Z measurement.
